subject: general
question: Who took oath as the new Chief Minister of Maharashtra in June 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Eknath Sambhaji Shinde.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Eknath Sambhaji Shinde is a member of the Shiv Sena party and was sworn in as the new Chief Minister of Maharashtra on June 6, 2022.**
 
• **Shinde succeeded Uddhav Thackeray**, who served as the** Chief Minister of Maharashtra from 2019 to 2022.**
 
• Before becoming the Chief Minister, Shinde held various positions in the Maharashtra government, including Minister of Public Works and Minister of Water Resources.
 
• Shinde is also known for his work in the field of agriculture and has been actively involved in farmers' movements in the state.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• Prithviraj Chavan is a former Chief Minister of Maharashtra who served from 2010 to 2014. He is a member of the Indian National Congress party.
 
• Uddhav Thackeray is a politician and the founder of the Shiv Sena party. He served as the Chief Minister of Maharashtra from 2019 to 2022.
 
• Devendra Fadnavis is a politician and a member of the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP). He served as the Chief Minister of Maharashtra from 2014 to 2019.
